fact: On 1 June 2021 technical tests began at the national data centre in Abomey-Calavi, built to host state systems and offer hosting capacity to semi-state and private-sector actors, with Tier 3 (ANSI/TIA 942) certification in progress.
title: Datacenter national : démarrage des premiers tests techniques sous le regard de la Ministre du Numérique et de la Digitalisation
